text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping district with Calstone Light O,
she suddenly let out a shout.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"‘Chokusen Hariganedo’!?
Trainer, let's go inside!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I see a ramen shop.
The sign indeed reads "Straight Harigane-do."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the specifics, but straight to
harigane firmness! It's bound to be delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
WELCOOOOME!! Table for two!!
Two orders of 'SprinTonkotsu Ramen', comin' right uuup?!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Which walleye pollock would you like for your kamaboko!?
Once you've decided, please grab it with a clothespin!

...I was handed a stainless steel clothespin.
Inside the holding tank, Alaska pollocks are swimming vigorously around, but...—what on earth is this!?

text_block_list.name: Alaska Pollock
text_block_list.text: (――*flop!! Flop flop!!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? That fish cake just moved...!
Just like a real fish! Wh-Whyyy...~!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get this at all...!
Everything about this restaurant is just way too chaotic...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ho, turning this swift walleye pollock into kamaboko in an instant?!
Magnificent! I'm looking forward to it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Order up!!
Two bowls of Sprin-tonkotsu ramen!

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
First, please try our shop's prized kamaboko!
While it's fresh! Ah, and also—

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
――...
...May the blessings of Ra-men be upon you as well.
choice_data_list: (A blessing...? What even is it, really...??)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was super fast! And all the toppings are lined up so straight! The noodles, the green onions, the chicken chashu, and the kamaboko too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Before the noodles get soggy—let's eat them while they're still extra firm! Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...True, it'd be a waste to let them get soggy.
I decided to focus on the ramen for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Slurrrp)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――! The noodle firmness is definitely wire-hard...!
It's extremely firm, this is――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The firm noodles pair perfectly with the rich tonkotsu broth!
The balance of meat and vegetables was spot on too, and by the time I finished, I was completely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So this is harigane noodles...! Delicious!
Harigane is... amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was forgetting something,
but just as I thought, "Oh well, whatever..."

text_block_list.name: Neighboring Customer
text_block_list.text:
――Hey there, customer. Sounds like the next gathering is in three months.
May the guidance of Rah-men be with you too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...A meeting? What was that just now?
Are they going to put on a tuna-cutting show or something?
choice_data_list: W-Well... I have no idea at all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that was utterly exhausting...
They even gave me fish cake boards as a souvenir...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The ramen was delicious, but...
I wonder what that 'meeting' was all about...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems no one else knows anything about
the "gathering" either... nor, of course, about
the kamaboko board souvenir...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What is this? Power is surging right through me!
I feel like I could run faster than ever right now!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's run. Right now.
—HAAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't understand what had just happened,
but I decided to chalk today's events up to a bizarre episode of daily life... for now.
